What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[A Brave Resistance]]: left, the image of [[A Brave Resistance]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[A Brave Resistance (Errata)]] (holotable commit fdfe14b). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/abraveresistance.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/fdfe14b7f81967a10e659a872abdeebecd8c5a25/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/abraveresistance.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
